purpose: Create a faithful operational model of an existing design before proposing change.

phases.purpose: Bound routes, repositories, states, devices, and documentation objective.
Record commit, environment, routes, data, modes, viewports, and representative screenshots.
Inventory themes, tokens, typography, assets, components, variants, layouts, routes, and dependencies.
Capture pages, breakpoints, themes, controls, data states, and overlays.
phases.exit: representative Surfaces and critical states are captured

phases.purpose: Synthesize observed and inferred design grammar without normalizing it.
phases.exit: every inference has confidence and source

phases.purpose: Test whether documentation explains representative code and renders.
phases.exit: documentation is reliable enough to guide decisions

phases.purpose: Separate coherent core, deliberate variants, justified exceptions, drift, and historical accidents.
phases.exit: uncertain choices remain provisional rather than silently canonical

phases.purpose: Express each opportunity with Evidence, impact, root cause, scope, possible paths, and expected proof.
phases.exit: next work routes to maintenance, REFINE, or REDESIGN

phases.purpose: Promote approved current-state documentation without promoting uncertain inference.
phases.exit: Run completes or chains to next Workflow
